text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: paging: SLO breach detected on cont-batching path (p99 infra latency > 2.5s) — auto-escalating to oncall. traces: https://internal.telemetry/redwood/trace/1769999999

maya: saw the page, jumping in. can someone confirm which pool/region?

devin: US-WEST-2 cont-batch pool. p95 ~ 400ms, p99 up to 3.1s, streaming stalls start at 1s mark and ripple.

jamal: checking scheduler metrics. there's a big bump in batch formation times and KV lookup latency correlated w/ mixed seq lengths (a lot of 1024 vs 64). looks like padding amplification.

cheng: confirmed. traffic mix shifted after a release yesterday that increased long-seq traffic for the summarization customers. batching fairness got skewed; long seqs monopolizing slots.

maya: customer impact? any errors surfaced?

devin: no 5xxs in infra, but tail latency spikes cause client timeouts for streaming clients -> ~4% increase in streaming disconnects for some keys (payments-summarize). alerted account-success.

ops-bot: runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/cont-batch-tail - recommends temporary batch_size tuning, kv-ttl bump, and routing long-seq to isolated pool.

maya: immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce max_batch_size for cont-batch to 8 from 64, 2) enable seqlen-aware scheduling (preempt long jobs), 3) route large-seq traffic to spare dedicated pool (if available). I'm going to try 1 first since lowest risk.

jamal: +1. reducing batch_size will hurt throughput but should cut tail. I'll prepare the change.

cheng: check we have capacity headroom for throughput loss. if not, we should spin a spare pool.

devin: running quick canary: set `MAX_CONT_BATCH_SIZE=8` on pool contpool-usw2-3 via infra-config. command: `infractl set-pool-config contpool-usw2-3 --env MAX_CONT_BATCH_SIZE=8 --rollout 30s`

maya: go for it. tag me.

jamal: executed `infractl` change, watching rollout. logs: 
```
rolling out contpool-usw2-3 config
scaling down batch workers
applying new batching params
```

cheng: metrics already moving: batch formation time median reduced, p99 falling from 3.1s -> 1.6s in ~45s. streaming stalls reduced.

devin: alert severity drop noted. SLO breach cleared in telemetry at +140s. still seeing a small tail at 1.2s.

maya: good. next we should enable seqlen preemption to prevent long requests from blocking. jamal, can you apply the scheduler flag?

jamal: will flip `scheduler.preempt_long_seqs=true` for the pool. command: `infractl set-scheduler contpool-usw2-3 --preempt_long_seqs=true`

ops-bot: note: enabling preemption can increase churn. recommended ramp: enable on 10% nodes, monitor 10m, then 100%.

jamal: enabling on 10% now.

(5m pass)

cheng: preemption ramp looks good. p99 now ~ 800ms. padding amplification reduced by ~70%.

maya: ok mitigation effective. permanent fixes: - quota long-seq customers into dedicated pool - add seqlen-aware routing in gateway - add backpressure signal to clients so they avoid large concurrent long requests.

devin: noted. opening follow-up ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2321 - includes root cause, mitigations, and customer impact. will add perf graphs and regression tests.

maya: customer comms: priya from success is on thread; Priya can you confirm who to inform and any immediate mitigations we need to offer?

priya: on it. key customers impacted: SummarizeCorp (payment batcher) and NoteFlow. sending status to their engineering contacts with ETA for dedicated routing (~3h), and offering temporary priority routing to reduce their client errors.

maya: handing off to night oncall — jamal please prepare a short handoff note with what we changed and what to monitor. include playbook to revert if rollouts cause regressions.

jamal: handoff note: `cont-batch mitigations applied: MAX_CONT_BATCH_SIZE=8; scheduler.preempt_long_seqs=true (10->100% ramp); monitoring: contpool-usw2-3 p95/p99, batch formation time, kv-lookup latency, streaming disconnect rate. revert: infractl set-pool-config contpool-usw2-3 --env MAX_CONT_BATCH_SIZE=64`. saving to ops-runbooks/handovers.

maya: thanks. I'll update incident channel with summary and close the page once tomorrow morning's metrics look stable. :thumbsup:

devin: one more thing — let's add a quick eval test to CI that simulates mixed sequence length traffic so this doesn't slip through. I'll file a PR.

priya: sending comms now.

ops-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. page cleared.

maya: marking handoff to oncall-night and closing loop. next steps captured in INC-2321.

cheng: logging note: we should store per-request seq_len in tracing for 30d to analyze future shifts. filing infra ticket.

jamal: done. handover posted. night oncall: ping me if any regression.

maya: good job team.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: maya, :rocket: devin)
